description: Start a Google Maps rank check for a business, found by Google Place id or by business name and city: where the business ranks at 49 points on a grid within 8 miles. The result gives the business's rank at each point, summary figures, and the names and positions of the top listings at each point. A finished result is saved and reused for seven days. The user is never charged. This check has a limited daily allowance shared by everyone, so it may be unavailable later in the day; the result then says quota_reached with the reset time (UTC). For a running result, call get_audit_report with runId. That call waits up to about 40 seconds for the run to finish before it answers. Repeat while status is running. Cached completed results need no polling.

businessName.description: Business name as it appears on Google.

city.description: City, required with businessName when no placeId is given.

placeId.description: Google Place id, for example ChIJ....

state.description: US state, two-letter code or full name.

trade.description: Trade, for example hvac, plumbing, auto repair, marine. Optional; inferred when omitted.

name: check_local_rank
title: Check Google Maps rank
